scope: M7 known-seed lateral-candidate commissioning; two reused development scenes, not confirmatory evidence
findings: Normal/easy1.5mm succeed in all three systems on both known scenes, without V2 recovery. At3/6/12/24mm both nominal systems fail, V1 detects depth failure, and V2 rescues all eight matched development failures with one bounded episode each.

All36 acquisition/readiness checks pass. All30 nonzero offsets apply before meaningful contact; achieved pre-insertion positive-Y offsets track the requested geometry-scaled family, with no contact at the pre-insertion snapshot.

All eight retries complete backout, once-only geometry refresh, realign, reinsert and verify; no extra attempts or enlarged budgets. Diagnosis agrees with the independent failure and detection occurs12 control actions after reference onset.

Baseline/V1 full-budget pairs and V1/V2 prefixes plus normal/disturbed pre-injection controls remain exact. Old velocity shadow reports failure on all36 trajectories and never gates controller execution.

This commissions the final proposed magnitude family and controller/scorer on two known scenes. It is not fresh-seed generalization, a neural training run, or proof of physical/non-privileged robustness.
